name: Cats of Meow York (COMY)
neighborhoods: Woodhaven, Queens (+ other parts of NYC)
notes: High-volume 501(c)(3) (EIN 88-1221020), founded 2017 as The Crazy Cat Family, rebranded 2022. Heavy TNRM + SPECIALTY in neonatal kitten care. One of few NYC rescues with a holding space. Queens-based, works other parts of NYC too. Intake: Contact + foster/adopt apps on site Intake: Linktree in IG bio Other channel: founder Farhana Haq Other channel: women-of-color-led
